title: Add a convention-aligned application
description: Create an application through the same maintained preset used by create-megamono.

name.description: Application basename; defaults to the selected type.

directory.description: Workspace-relative application root; defaults to apps/<name>.

scope.description: Megamono scope tag and package scope.

styling.description: Styling tool used to render the generated web/site billboard. Auto detects the workspace and falls back to CSS Modules.

router.description: Next.js router for web/site applications. Defaults to Pages Router; not a router migration command.

interactive.description: Allow unresolved choices and confirmation to be prompted.

yes.description: Apply a fully resolved plan without confirmation.

dryRun.description: Print the ordered plan and write nothing.
